summary: COSMOS RPG is an interactive open-world RPG browser game where players design complete NASA-style space missions. Players navigate a solar system with 11 real bodies and complete a 7-step Mission Designer covering objective, orbit, spacecraft, scientific instruments, launch vehicle, communications, and power systems. Each decision affects budget, mass, and power in real time. After designing the mission, players simulate a launch with dynamic events (solar storms, debris alerts, signal anomalies) and receive a scored post-mission analysis explaining why their mission succeeded or failed. The game features difficulty levels, mission duration selection, data bandwidth analysis, and an RPG skill system with real NASA mission quests including Artemis III, Mars Sample Return, and Europa Clipper. All data sourced from NASA public resources.
details:
COSMOS RPG — Space Mission Designer is a fully interactive browser-based RPG game that simulates the complete lifecycle of a NASA space mission.

WHAT IT DOES:

Players take the role of a Space Commander who navigates an animated solar system with 11 real celestial bodies, each loaded with accurate NASA data. They interact with AI NPCs based on real NASA missions (Perseverance, DART, Cassini, Juno, Voyager 2, MESSENGER) that provide factual scientific dialogue.

The 7-Step Mission Designer guides players through every critical engineering decision:

1. Mission Objective (Earth observation, Mars exploration, Moon return, asteroid defense, climate monitoring, astronomy)

2. Orbital Parameters (altitude slider, inclination, orbit type: LEO/MEO/GEO/Heliocentric/Lunar with real physics calculations)

3. Spacecraft Platform (CubeSat 6U to Interplanetary Probe — each with real mass/power limits)

4. Scientific Instruments (9 instruments with real mass, power, data rate, and cost tradeoffs)

5. Launch Vehicle (Rocket Lab Electron, Falcon 9, Atlas V, NASA SLS, Starship, Ariane 6 — with compatibility checks)

6. Communications + Power Systems (bandwidth analysis showing if comms can handle data generated by instruments)

7. Pre-launch Review (all constraints checked: budget, mass, power, launcher compatibility)

After launch, a simulation plays with dynamic events (X9 solar flares, space debris, anomalous SETI signals, exoplanet discoveries, international cooperation) requiring real engineering decisions. The mission is scored 0–150 points with a detailed post-mission analysis explaining exactly why each decision helped or hurt the mission.

RPG SYSTEM: 5 skills (Engineering, Science, Navigation, Command, Astrobiology), experience points, skill trees, crew management, morale, fuel, and an inventory system. Quests are based on real NASA missions.

DIFFICULTY LEVELS: Easy (expanded budget for learning), Normal (real NASA constraints), Expert (no margin for error).

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY:

- Language: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (vanilla, no frameworks)

- Canvas API for solar system rendering and animations

- Single self-contained file (145 KB) — no backend, no database, no installation

- Tailwind CSS (via Google CDN) for UI components

- Built with Google Antigravity AI assistance (Gemini) for code generation and NASA data integration

CREATIVITY:

The game bridges the gap between individual space concepts and integrated mission engineering. Rather than teaching orbital mechanics OR spacecraft design OR budgeting in isolation, COSMOS RPG shows how ALL these systems interact simultaneously — exactly as real NASA mission teams experience them. The RPG layer makes the learning process engaging and replayable.

IMPACT:

Any student, educator, or space enthusiast worldwide can access this game instantly from any browser without installing anything. The post-mission analysis provides genuine educational feedback explaining the engineering tradeoffs behind every decision.
